dates.text: genito talis decembris, anno a Nativitate Domini millesimo quadringentesimo quadragesimo

data.summary: Felix V grants the commendatory administration of the priorate of Saint Peter of Castelleto to Johannes Martinus de Advocatis de Casmana, abbot of the Cluniac monastery, to provide him with a pension of 400 florins.
